rendered.subject: Collaboration Opportunity for a Tonal Instagram Post
rendered.body:
Hi Tonal team,

We’re a small team of Instagram content creators dedicated to bringing stories to life through visual content. We’d like to propose a collaborative Instagram post with Tonal, built around the fact that Tonal has seen huge growth at the start of Covid-19, but needed to connect more with high-income individuals and athletes to build the brand interest and value, in a highly competitive market [P4]. Essentially, you're looking for a way to showcase Tonal's unique approach to home fitness and its appeal to discerning consumers. The post would feature a visually striking, black and white shot of Tonal in a Victorian-era setting, highlighting its design and the idea of a luxurious, immersive experience. It would be a chance for Tonal to share a specific moment of their holiday sales boost with a touch of nostalgia [P9].

We’d love to hear your thoughts on this idea and suggest how we could work together to bring it to life.

The BrandPilot team
